question: In which of the following Indian cities was the Prarthana Samaj, which believed in the spiritual equality of all castes, founded in the 19th century?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Prarthana Samaj** was founded in the **19th century** in **Bombay**.
 
• It was established in **1867** under the inspiration of **Keshab Chandra Sen**, a prominent leader of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• The organization focused on promoting **social reforms**, including the abolition of caste discrimination and child marriage.
 
• The Prarthana Samaj believed in the **spiritual equality of all castes** and advocated for the upliftment of marginalized sections of society.
 
• It emphasized the importance of **monotheistic worship** and rejected rituals and idol worship.
 
• **M.G. Ranade**, a leading figure of the Prarthana Samaj, worked towards **widow remarriage, education of women, and eradication of caste barriers**.
 
• Members of the Prarthana Samaj were deeply influenced by the **ideas of the Brahmo Samaj** and Western thought, advocating for **social and religious reforms**.
 
• It became a significant movement in the **Indian renaissance**, especially in **Maharashtra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kanpur**__

 __
 
• **Kanpur** is a major industrial city in the state of Uttar Pradesh, but it does not have any direct connection to the founding of the **Prarthana Samaj**.
 
• It is historically known for its role in the **Indian freedom struggle** and as a center of trade and commerce.
 
 
 
• **Mysore**__
 __
 
• **Mysore** is a city in Karnataka, known for its rich **cultural heritage** and historical significance.
 
• It played a prominent role during the reign of the **Wodeyar dynasty** but does not have any association with the **Prarthana Samaj**.
 
 
 
• **Jodhpur**__
 
 
• **Jodhpur**, located in Rajasthan, is famous for its **historical forts and palaces**, such as the Mehrangarh Fort.
 
• It has no connection to the activities or founding of the **Prarthana Samaj**.
